name: Turbo Flow — the rig-lite kit
postCreateCommand:
chmod +x ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/rig-lite/*.sh ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/setup-harness.sh ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/workspace.sh 2>/dev/null || true; bash ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/rig-lite/self-test.sh; command -v tmux >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo apt-get install -y tmux 2>/dev/null || echo 'tmux install failed - the 5-window workspace needs it; setup-harness still works'; grep -q 'tf-boot' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || printf '
# tf-boot: first interactive shell gets the harness menu (once, atomic); every interactive shell lands INSIDE the tmux rig
if [[ -t 0 && -t 1 && -n "$TF_HOME" ]]; then
  if [[ ! -e "$HOME/.config/turbo-flow/harness-booted" && -f "$TF_HOME/setup-harness.sh" ]] && mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/turbo-flow" 2>/dev/null && mkdir "$HOME/.config/turbo-flow/harness-booted" 2>/dev/null; then
    ( cd "$TF_HOME" && bash ./setup-harness.sh )
  fi
  if [[ -z "${TMUX:-}" && -f "$TF_HOME/workspace.sh" ]] && command -v tmux >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ( cd "$TF_HOME" && exec bash ./workspace.sh )
  fi
fi
' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
